description: Add (or, with a negative number, subtract) business days to a date, skipping weekends and public holidays of the country (and region). Returns the result date and the holidays skipped. Read-only. Same engine, cache and limits as GET /v1/add.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, DE, GB. See list_countries.

days.description: Business days to add; negative counts backwards.

region.description: Optional region/state code for countries with regional holidays, e.g. DE-BY, US-CA (or just BY).

types.description: Optional holiday types that close business days: comma list of public, bank (default: public; "all" = public,bank).

weekend.description: Optional weekend days, comma list of day names like "sat,sun" (default) or "fri,sat", or "none".

name: add_business_days
title: Add or subtract business days from a date
